title: Zoho CRM MCP Servers: Connect Claude to Zoho CRM Step by Step (2026)
description:
Zoho CRM now has built-in MCP (Model Context Protocol) support: four pre-built MCP servers let AI tools like Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf work with your CRM in plain language - no code and no server to host. In this video: what MCP is, what each server does (Data Insights - read-only; Data Operations; Module Customization; Workflow & Process Automation), how to connect Claude Desktop step by step (Zoho CRM > Setup > Developer Hub > MCP for AI Agents > copy the server link; Claude Desktop > Customize > Connectors > Add Custom Connector > Remote MCP Server URL > Add > Connect), example prompts, and the guardrails: your CRM role limits what the AI can do, OAuth sign-in, recycle bin for deleted records, and API credits for every MCP call.
